inputs: public repository fixtures only; copied outside the research and product repositories

assertions.communication: Iteration options equal the numeric step suffixes independently read from cluster_communication.json; request identity connects transport, decoded request, concrete handler, database, response and options consumer.
assertions.snapshot: Merged graph blocks equal independently reconstructed allocation lifetimes from the primitive snapshot trace, for the selected device and slice; every page belongs to its request; Worker receives the same block count and reports completion for the adopted generation.
assertions.pagination: Default page size control and an explicitly versioned smaller-page experiment return the same block identities; page concatenation has no omission or duplicate.
assertions.replacement: After a newer context starts, an old held response must not be adopted into the current context; held, released, discarded and still pending requests remain distinguishable.
assertions.failure: A controlled failed response cannot become a successful completed graph; failed loading clears or is explicitly classified pending.
assertions.cache: First eligible context misses and builds; repeated eligible context hits without blocks network fetch; explicit removal causes miss and rebuild. Observe completion before classifying persistence.
assertions.fault: Dropping one merged block before Worker transfer must violate the predeclared independent block-set assertion; identical control and restored runs must pass.
assertions.mapping: Only committed matching source/build/config snapshots can be overlaid; changed source or config rejects reuse; unmapped observations remain visible.

resources: OPFS file entries and physical file bytes
Worker reported logical and buffer metrics
backend and browser process working set where available
coverage_unit: named executed scenarios, not exhaustive runtime paths
historical_validation_samples: not used to develop these mechanisms
